title: Strict Roos data for integral pullback
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and its chosen uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use its small pro-etale site, retaining object universe $u+1$ and morphism universe $u$ for $W:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $d$ be the uniformizer-adic coefficient datum, $A_{n,W}=(A/\pi^{n+1})_W$, and $R_W=\varprojlim_{n\in\mathbf N}A_{n,W}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. The site-size instance and the notations $d,R_W$ mean these existing constructions, not extra choices.

Use the cochain complexes of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For any ring sheaf $B$ on this site, set $\operatorname{TowCx}(W,B)=\operatorname{CoCh}(\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(B)))$. Write $H_B$ for the strict Roos functor, $P(I)=\prod_n I_n$ for its degreewise product and $\chi_{I,p}:H_B(I)^{p+1}\cong P(I)^p\oplus P(I)^{p+1}$ for its specified cone coordinates [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. Let $L_B$ be ordinary tower limit and $\mathbf RL_B$ its total right derived functor, with the canonical localization comparison $\eta_I:Q(L_B I)\to\mathbf RL_B(QI)$ [def-pur-completed-rlim-functor]. Define the comparison type to be the natural isomorphisms $\kappa:QH_B\cong\mathbf RL_B Q$ and the inclusion type to be the natural transformations $j:L_B\to H_B$ on tower complexes. Define $\operatorname{limitProduct}_{I,q}:\varprojlim_n I_n^q\to P(I)^q$ by the limit projections followed by the inverse canonical evaluation/product comparison. Define $\operatorname{IsUnitNormalized}(W,B,\kappa,j)$ to mean both
$$\chi_{I,p}\circ j_I^{p+1}=(0,\operatorname{limitProduct}_{I,p+1})\quad( I\in\operatorname{TowCx}(W,B),\ p\in\mathbf Z),\qquad \kappa_I\circ Q(j_I)=\eta_I\quad(I\in\operatorname{TowCx}(W,B)).$$

For a scheme morphism $g:X\to Y$, let $g_R^*$ be the actual module inverse image along the canonical completed-coefficient structure map and let $\operatorname{red}_Y(M)=(M\otimes_{R_Y}A_{n,Y})_n$ with its actual quotient transitions [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Define $\operatorname{towerPull}_g$ by applying $g_R^*$ levelwise, $T_g=\operatorname{towerPull}_g\circ\operatorname{red}_Y$, and $\operatorname{cxT}_g$ by applying $T_g$ degreewise. For each cochain complex $P$ of $R_Y$-modules define the canonical counit
$$\operatorname{towerCounit}_{g,P}=\epsilon^{\operatorname{towerPull}}_{g,\operatorname{red}^{\rm cx}_Y P}\circ L\operatorname{towerPull}_g(\epsilon^{\operatorname{red}}_{Y,P}):L\operatorname{towerPull}_g(\operatorname{red}^{D}_Y(QP))\longrightarrow Q(\operatorname{cxT}_g P),$$
where the two $\epsilon$ are the existing representative counits for derived reduction and derived levelwise pullback. These are definitions on arbitrary schemes and arbitrary complexes; no completeness, constructibility, K-flatness or finite-type hypothesis is imposed.
